courses.name: Foundations
courses.blurb: Charge, current, voltage, resistance, Ohm's law, power, AC vs DC, meters and safety.

courses.name: Components
courses.blurb: Resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, LEDs, BJT/MOSFET intro and sensors.

courses.name: Circuits
courses.blurb: Series/parallel, Kirchhoff, dividers, RC timing, filters, amplifiers and schematics.

courses.name: Digital
courses.blurb: Logic levels, gates, Boolean, flip-flops, clocks, GPIO and UART/SPI/I²C.

courses.name: Soldering
courses.blurb: Tools, through-hole technique, flux, joint quality, ESD, desoldering and rework.

courses.name: PCB design
courses.blurb: Schematic capture, footprints, layout, pours, DRC, fab files and assembly.

courses.name: Systems
courses.blurb: Supplies, grounding, noise, EMC intuition, batteries and embedded bring-up.
